# Support

AI Bulk Chat Manager is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Read the user guide first

The [user guide](https://ehsanenaloo.github.io/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/) covers installing, selecting chats, deleting, archiving and exporting, the settings, and what to do when a site stops working.

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first. Someone may have asked already.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include your extension version, browser and the steps to repeat the problem. In the extension, **Options, Privacy, Copy diagnostics** gives you text you can paste into the report. It contains no chat titles or links. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs-well) explains what makes a good report.

## A site changed and something stopped working

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok change their pages from time to time. If checkboxes, Select all, Load all older chats, Delete, Archive or Export stopped working, use the [supported site changed form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues/new?template=site_changed.yml). Switching **Fast mode** off in the Options page (Behavior) is a useful thing to try first, and worth mentioning in the report.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first. This project stays local and asks for few permissions, so some ideas will not fit.

## Fix a translation

Use the [translation fix form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or send a pull request. See [Translations](CONTRIBUTING.md#translations).

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/AI-Bulk-Chat-Manager/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Privacy questions

Read the [privacy policy](../docs/PRIVACY.md). For a question it does not answer, open an issue. Do not include personal data.

## Please never post

Chat titles, chat links, conversation text, session cookies or access tokens. None of them are needed to fix a problem, and issues are public.

## What to expect

- Help is given by a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, and there is no guaranteed response time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue and pull request.

If you want to support the project, you can [buy the maintainer a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/enaloo) or leave a rating in your browser's store. Neither is expected, and neither changes how issues are handled.

If you want to help others, answering a question in an issue is a good way to contribute. Developers can run the unit tests with `node scripts/test.mjs`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#checks).
